sourceNote: ElectionsIreland.org files this contest under its later area name "Pembroke" (cons 193). In 1979 Dublin Corporation was elected in eleven numbered areas, set by the Dublin County Borough (Electoral Areas) Order, 1979 (S.I. No. 41 of 1979); this is Dublin City Number Ten, the area where Joe Doyle, the one candidate on file, was elected (IrelandElection.com, Area No. 10), filed under IrelandElection.com's name for it.
